hints.title: Digital Root Congruence
hints.text: Repeatedly summing decimal digits computes the digital root, which mirrors arithmetic modulo 9.

hints.title: Zero and Multiples of Nine Boundary
hints.text: If num is zero, the answer is zero. If num is a positive multiple of 9, the repeated sum always converges to 9.

hints.title: Constant Time Formula Evaluation
hints.text: Combine cases into the closed form: return 0 if num equals 0 else 1 + (num - 1) % 9.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(1) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Looping through decimal digit extractions takes logarithmic time instead of the demanded O(1) constant time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Mathematical digital root property evaluates directly in a single arithmetic operation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should derive or state the digital root congruence formula rather than resorting to iteration.
